title: Nylium Network
description: A server network for alterhumans (incl., but not limited to, otherkin, plural systems, therians, fictionkin, soulbonders, linkers, and otherhearted folk). We currently sport our own SMP and two "tour worlds" (hosted MYCT world downloads).
body:
The Nylium Network Minecraft server is a small, **whitelisted** server network geared toward **[alterhumans](https://otherkin.wiki/wiki/Alterhuman)** with Java-Bedrock crossplay. [Join our Fluxer community](https://fluxer.gg/wvx0IOGW) to get whitelisted on the network.

You may be interested if you are...
* a plural system,
* otherkin or a therian,
* fictionkin or factkin,
* an otherlinker or copinglinker,
* a soulbonder,
* otherhearted,
* a furry lifestyler,
* or alterhuman in any other way.

## Gamemodes
### Nylium SMP
[Click here for a live map of the world.](https://map.nylium.network/)

Our SMP world is generated using [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/mod/tectonic) and has a couple extra features. [Switchy](https://modrinth.com/mod/switchy) is a PluralKit-like mod that allows you to create individual profiles on the server. Our `/status` command allows you to set a "recording status", to let other players know your comfort level for roleplay and being recorded or livestreamed.

### Tour worlds
We have two "tour worlds" and will likely add more in the future. These are hosted world downloads of worlds from MCYT. We currently offer, for your exploration, the Dream SMP and the world from Searching For/Destroying A World That Doesn't Exist. The tour worlds allow you to switch between adventure and spectator modes.

## About us
The Nylium Network is a group focused on technology for alterhumans. What started as a Discord server for Minecraft fictionkin/factkin and fictives/factives is expanding into other areas of interest such as audiovisual art (video content creation) and coding and webhosting. [Read more about us on our website.](https://nylium.network/)
